Author: Serpens66
Name: AIV Placement Lobby
Description: Asynchronously evaluates and caches offline AIV placement requests from the current skirmish lobby without changing the visible UI.

Changes: Evaluate every selected AIV candidate asynchronously in native import order and aggregate the deterministic best fit.
Cache map snapshots and placement results with bounded, file-invalidated keys including advopt_pre_build and the analyzer version.
Log cache behavior and separate parse, snapshot, projection and rule timings while discarding stale generations on the main thread.
Capture selected map, AI player slot, keep assignment, AIV candidates, initial rotation and advopt_pre_build on every relevant lobby generation.
Keep prebuild mode explicitly NotEvaluable until sequential support is implemented, and reject stale generations by identity.
